messages:
joel (sales): FYI CardinalPay just flagged a big perf hit after last night's rollout — they see checkout latency P95 ~3x baseline and some timeouts. they reported failures in production that's impacting conversion. Can product + SRE triage?
anya (support): they opened a ticket (#C-1629). timeline: regression started 02:12 UTC after the 01:50 deploy. customer logs show many 504s and elevated token generation time. i've pasted the small stack snippet they sent: ```
2026-03-19T02:15:34Z ERROR request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=1247 status=504
2026-03-19T02:16:11Z WARN request_id=def456 queue_wait_ms=310
```
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T01:50:12 by @infra-ci to pool/hosted-shared/model-v2.4 completed :rocket:
sam (sre): looking now. first pass: can you share a sample request_id from the customer? also which model was routed for them (we have both v2.4 and v2.3 live)?
joel (sales): customer pasted two ids in ticket: abc123 and def456 (above). they were routed to model-v2.4 as we rolled it as default yesterday.
sam (sre): running a quick query against logs for those ids, seeing long kv-cache miss times and increased batch sizes around that timeframe. suspect batching policy change in v2.4 + longer generation per token. query i ran: ```select request_id, batch_size, gen_ms from request_logs where request_id in ('abc123','def456');```
maria (pm): Need decision: Is this a platform-wide regression or only affecting large request/checkout shapes? If platform-wide -> P0 rollback/mitigation. If limited to checkout shapes -> targeted routing change for CardinalPay and customers with similar shapes. Also we need launch criteria for v2.4 rollback vs patch.
anya (support): CardinalPay uses short chat completions (~50 tokens) but at high QPS during nightly batch jobs. they said conversion dropped ~12% in the window. they want a timeline for fix — urgent.
sam (sre): given current evidence, looks shape-specific (small tokens, high QPS) hitting a new batching heuristic in v2.4. recommend immediate mitigation: route CardinalPay to v2.3 (fallback) and add a temporary routing rule for similar customers. I can push that now if product ops approves.
maria (pm): approved for temporary routing. maria (pm): Action items: 1) sam to push routing for CardinalPay -> v2.3 (rollback for them only) 2) eng-runtime to add perf regression test for small-token high-qps shape 3) product to create a backlog ticket for batching heuristic rollback or patch and prioritize in tomorrow's roadmap sync. Acceptance criteria: p95 for CardinalPay back to baseline within 24h, root cause triaged, regression test in CI.
sam (sre): I'll apply the routing rule and monitor. I'll report p95 in 15m. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform for follow-up.
joel (sales): i've told the customer we'll route them to v2.3 and update within 20m. they're relieved but want a formal timeline for the permanent fix.
maria (pm): i'll create the product ticket with scope/acceptance and link to the customer ticket (#C-1629). owners: maria (product) + sam (sre) + eng-runtime lead for the code change. i'll add priority=P1 but we can escalate to P0 if more customers show up. :white_check_mark:
